### usb-backup-weekly.service
[Unit]
Description=USB Backup (weekly)

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/usb-backup-cli run --quiet-skip
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
Nice=10
IOSchedulingClass=idle
TimeoutStartSec=12h

### usb-backup-weekly.timer
[Unit]
Description=USB Backup (weekly)

[Timer]
OnCalendar=Fri *-*-* 18:00:00
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
